objectives_fil: Sa isang sensitibong usapan, kilalanin ang concern, magbigay ng isang hakbang na saklaw ng BHW at ipasabi ito sa sariling salita ng kausap.
objectives_en: In a sensitive conversation, acknowledge the concern, give one next step within the BHW role and ask the person to explain it in their own words.

sections.takeaway_fil: Isang hakbang → sariling paliwanag → ayusin → mag-check muli. Hindi pa appointment ang pagtatanong sa iskedyul.
sections.takeaway_en: One step → their own explanation → repair → recheck. Asking about scheduling is not a confirmed appointment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pakinggan ang concern. Alamin ang contact sa health team. Igalang ang pagpili; hindi BHW ang pumipili ng paraan.
sections.takeaway_en: Hear the concern. Verify the contact with the health team. Respect choice; the BHW does not select the method.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig at alamin ang kwalipikadong contact. Sa agarang panganib, huwag antalahin ang tulong para sa ordinaryong interview.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen and identify a qualified contact. In immediate danger, do not delay help for an ordinary interview.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi ng pahintulot, pakinggan ang layunin, mag-alok ng isang natiyak na hakbang at gamitin ang teach-back.
sections.takeaway_en: Ask permission, hear the person’s goal, offer one verified step and use teach-back.

sections.takeaway_fil: Concern → isang hakbang → sariling paliwanag → repair → recheck. Lahat ay susubok bilang BHW; direktang obserbasyon ang ebidensiya.
sections.takeaway_en: Concern → one step → their own explanation → repair → recheck. Everyone tries the BHW role; direct observation supplies evidence.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag iba ang pagkaunawa, ayusin ang sariling paliwanag at mag-check muli. Hindi kasalanan ng kausap ang hindi malinaw na mensahe.
sections.takeaway_en: When understanding differs, repair your explanation and check again. An unclear message is not the person’s fault.

check.prompt_fil: Sa teach-back, iba ang planong ikinuwento ni Liza. Ano ang susunod?
check.prompt_en: During teach-back, Liza describes a different plan. What next?

options.fil: Sabihing mali at tapusin ang usapan.
options.en: Say it is wrong and end the conversation.

options.fil: Ibigay ang parehong paliwanag nang mas mabilis.
options.en: Give the same explanation more quickly.

options.fil: Ipaliwanag sa ibang paraan at ipasabi muli ang hakbang.
options.en: Explain another way and ask her to describe the step again.

check.feedback_fil: Una: Ang pagsisi at pagtatapos ay hindi nag-aayos ng hindi malinaw na mensahe at maaaring magpatahimik kay Liza. Ikalawa: Ang parehong paliwanag nang mas mabilis ay hindi tumutugon sa maling pagkaunawa. Ikatlo: Ang ibang paraan ng paliwanag at pag-check muli ay angkop; si Gibs ang may pananagutan sa linaw. Sa wakas, sabi ni Gibs, “Hindi pa appointment. Magtatanong muna tayo tungkol sa iskedyul. Ano muna ang gagawin natin?” Sagot ni Liza, “Magtatanong tungkol sa iskedyul; wala pang kumpirmadong appointment.” “Tama, iyon muna,” tugon ni Gibs.
check.feedback_en: First: Blame and ending the conversation do not repair an unclear message and may silence Liza. Second: The same explanation delivered faster does not address the misunderstanding. Third: Explaining another way and checking again is appropriate; Gibs takes responsibility for clarity. In the ending, Gibs says, “This is not an appointment yet. We will ask about scheduling first. What will we do first?” Liza replies, “Ask about the schedule; there is no confirmed appointment.” “Yes, that is the first step,” Gibs confirms.
